sentences.text:
The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Subba Reddy Satti
 Criminal Petition No.4653 of 2022
Order:

Accused No.2 in Crime No.100 of 2022 of Pullala Cheruvu Police Station, Prakasham District, filed the above criminal petition under Section 438 of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short "Cr.P.C.,") seeking pre-arrest bail.

entities.text: Pullala Cheruvu Police Station, Prakasham District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 2. The case of the prosecution is that on 29.05.2022, raid party while conducting search found the place where ID liquor is being manufactured.
Since nobody was found at the scene of offence, no mediators report was prepared.
Basing on the report lodged by Head Constable, the present crime is registered for the offence punishable under Section 7(A) read with 8(E) of the Andhra Pradesh Prohibition (Amendment) Act, 2020.

3. Heard Sri Eluru Sesha Mahesh Babu, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Special Assistant Public Prosecutor for State.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is Proprietor of Seetha Ramaiah Kirana Shop and he placed a copy of license with reference No.30220529110700932, dated 29.05.2022 issued by Government of Andhra Pradesh, Food Safety and Standards Authority of India, Food Safety Compliance System is placed before this Court.

entities.text: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Learned counsel submits that petitioner obtained requisite license and certificates from the concerned departments for doing kirana business and petitioner is no way concerned with the alleged offence and he is falsely implicated in the crime only basing on the confession of co-accused.

Learned counsel places reliance on G.O.Ms.No.149 dated 18.04.2017 issued by Revenue (Excise- II) Department and submits that as per the guidelines framed therein, jaggery or black jaggery is not a prohibited commodity and mere possession, selling or transportation shall not amount to commission an offence.
He would contend that the petitioner is not aware for which purpose jaggery was purchased from him.
Hence, he prays to grant pre-arrest bail to the petitioner.
5. Learned Special Assistant Public Prosecutor submits opposed the bail application on the ground that investigation is pending.
6. A perusal of license which is placed on record, shows that petitioner is a trader.
Further going by mediators' report, the petitioner was not present at the spot and no contraband was seized from his possession.
Further as per the guidelines framed in G.O.Ms.No.149, dated 18.04.2017, mere possession, selling or transportation shall not amount to commission an offence.
Therefore, this Court is inclined to grant bail to the petitioner.

7. Accordingly, the criminal petition is allowed and the petitioner/A2 shall be enlarged on bail, in the event of his arrest in connection with Crime No. 100 of 2022 of Pullala Cheruvu Police Station,
CRLP/4653/2022 on 15 July, 2022 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/4361170/
1 Prakasham District on his executing a bond for Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two sureties each for a like sum to the satisfaction of the Station House Officer, Pullala Cheruvu Police Station, Prakasham District.

entities.text: Pullala Cheruvu Police Station, Prakasham District
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Petitioner shall cooperate with investigation and shall appear before the investigating officer, as and when his presence is required and he shall produce the relevant account books and stock register as and when he is directed to do so.
Petitioner shall not influence the witnesses or tamper with evidence.

It is made clear that the findings in this order be construed as expression of opinion only for the limited purpose of considering the regular bail in the above crime and shall not have any bearing in any other proceedings.
As a sequel, all the pending miscellaneous applications shall stand closed.
